command:
# G1 (#17): make oracle DB=standard8 on Graviton (Linux aarch64), the canonical oracle platform.
# The code is the launch commit (the short sha that ends AK2_RUN_ID), cloned from GitHub. The
# database is the in-region copy declared first in AK2_DATASETS (a byte copy of the public
# genome-idx k2_standard_08_GB_20260626.tar.gz, which lives in us-east-1 and so cannot be
# declared here). Reads come from ENA over HTTPS (scripts/fetch-reads.sh). Results are pushed as
# soon as make oracle writes them; the run is not a benchmark (no cold rung, no drop_caches).
W=$HOME/ak2; mkdir -p "$W"
SHA=${AK2_RUN_ID##*-}
set -- $AK2_DATASETS
DBURI=$1; U=${DBURI#s3://}; B=${U%%/*}; K=${U#*/}

ak2_phase setup
sudo -n dnf install -y -q git gcc-c++ make zlib-devel perl jq bzip2 gzip tar > "$W/dnf.log" 2>&1
ak2_say "dnf install rc=$? ($(gcc --version | head -1))"
git clone -q https://github.com/scttfrdmn/aws-kraken2.git "$W/repo"
git -C "$W/repo" checkout -q "$SHA"
ak2_say "checkout $SHA rc=$? head=$(git -C "$W/repo" rev-parse HEAD)"
GOV=$(awk '$1=="go"{print $2}' "$W/repo/go.mod")
curl -fsSL "https://go.dev/dl/go$GOV.linux-$(uname -m | sed 's/aarch64/arm64/').tar.gz" | tar -xz -C "$W"
export PATH="$W/go/bin:$PATH"
ak2_say "go: $(go version) rc=$?"

ak2_phase stage
DB="$W/repo/.cache/db/k2_standard_08_GB_20260626"
mkdir -p "$DB"
aws s3api head-object --bucket "$B" --key "$K" > "$W/db-head.json"
ak2_say "head-object rc=$?"; ak2_req HeadObject 1 "$B"
SIZE=$(jq -r .ContentLength "$W/db-head.json")
ak2_stage "$DBURI" "$W/std8.tar.gz"
# aws s3 cp downloads in 8 MiB ranged GETs (the CLI default multipart_chunksize).
ak2_req GetObject-range $(( (SIZE + 8388607) / 8388608 )) "$B"
tar -xzf "$W/std8.tar.gz" -C "$DB"
ak2_say "extract rc=$? $(ls -l "$DB/hash.k2d" "$DB/opts.k2d" "$DB/taxo.k2d" | awk '{print $5, $9}' | tr '\n' ' ')"
printf 'source %s\netag %s\nfetched %s\norigin genome-idx/kraken/k2_standard_08_GB_20260626.tar.gz (public, us-east-1; this is its in-region copy)\n' \
  "$DBURI" "$(jq -r .ETag "$W/db-head.json" | tr -d '"')" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > "$DB/SOURCE"
ak2_push "$DB/SOURCE" db-SOURCE

ak2_phase build
cd "$W/repo" || exit 1
scripts/oracle-build.sh > "$W/oracle-build.out" 2>&1
ak2_say "oracle-build rc=$? $(tail -1 "$W/oracle-build.out")"
make build > "$W/make-build.out" 2>&1
ak2_say "make build rc=$?"

ak2_phase oracle
make oracle DB=standard8 ORACLE_THREADS=8 > "$W/oracle.out" 2>&1
RC=$?
ak2_say "make oracle DB=standard8 rc=$RC"
tail -5 "$W/oracle.out"

ak2_phase push
for d in results/g1/oracle-standard8-*/; do
  for f in "$d"*; do ak2_push "$f" "$(basename "$d")/$(basename "$f")"; done
done
ak2_push "$W/oracle.out" oracle.out
ak2_say "G1 oracle standard8 done rc=$RC"
exit $RC
